app.name: THE BLUE POINT
app.tagline: From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance

home.heroSubtitle: Coordinate daily well-being, healthcare access, and emergency safety for your loved ones, no matter where you live.
home.featuresSubtitle: A connected platform for safety, health, and community support.
home.featRemindersDesc: Medicine, meals, and hydration tracking with easy 'I am fine' check-ins.
home.featHelpDesc: Request groceries, transport, or hospital accompaniment from verified local helpers.
home.featSosDesc: Instant alerts to family and local responders. Honest live status tracking.
home.featFamilyDesc: Coordinate tasks, view status, and stay connected securely.
home.featHelpersDesc: Admin-verified volunteers and local helpers you can trust.
home.featConsentDesc: Strict data privacy under DPDP Act. You control what you share.
home.rolesSubtitle: Choose how you want to connect with the platform.
home.footerDisclaimer: This platform is NOT a replacement for emergency services. In case of an emergency, call 112 or 108 immediately.
home.footerRights: © 2026 THE BLUE POINT. Built for the community.
